A '''gravcouch''', or '''grav couch''', was a type of furniture for individuals to sit upon. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], gravcouches with [[Acceleration compensator/Legends|inertial damping]] technology were used aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Spiral-class Assault Ship|''Spiral''-class Assault Ships]] to protect the crew and passengers when the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] rammed other [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] in order to board them. Additionally, the [[Iyra]] [[sentientologist]] [[Tem Eliss]] had one of the [[Couch/Legends|couches]] in [[Gender/Legends|his]] office at the [[University of Sanbra]].

==Description==
A gravcouch,<ref name="AEG" /> also spelled as grav [[Couch/Legends|couch]],<ref name="Black Ice" /> was a type of furniture used as seating.<ref name="AEG" /> Some gravcouches were used on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and were designed with [[Acceleration compensator/Legends|inertial-damping]] technology in order to protect individuals from being injured in collisions.<ref name="Black Ice" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Spiral-class Assault Ship|''Spiral''-class Assault Ships]] were equipped with gravcouches. The inertial-damping technology in the gravcouches helped protect the vessel's passengers and crew when it rammed into another ship as part of its role as a boarding craft. The two captured ''Spiral''-class Assault Ships used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to [[Battle for Black Ice|board]] the Imperial [[Field Secured Container Vessel/Legends|Container Train]] ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]'' over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Refrax]] were equipped with gravcouches.<ref name="Black Ice" />

Around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="AIRDate">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' states that it is set approximately two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], which occurred in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Safonne Pendon]] had gravcouches along the walls of the lounge outside [[Gender/Legends|his]] office on his<ref name="AOTCR" /> [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian Corvette]]<ref name="WBC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> ''[[Safonne's Sword]]'' when he met with the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] pirates known as the [[Venithon Twins]].<ref name="AOTCR" />

In addition to ships, gravcouches were also sometimes used in other settings. The [[Iyra]] [[sentientologist]] [[Tem Eliss]] had a gravcouch in [[Gender/Legends|his]] office in the [[Sentient Studies Department]] at the [[University of Sanbra]] during the Galactic Civil War. When an [[Abinyshi]] named [[S'itl Thirr]] paid a surprise visit to Eliss one [[Standard day/Legends|day]], the Iyra asked his visitor to have a seat on the gravcouch.<ref name="AEG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The grav couch first appeared in [[Black Ice (adventure)|''Black Ice'']], a [[1990]] adventure book written by [[Paul Murphy]] and [[Bill Slavicsek]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]].<ref name="Black Ice" /> The furniture later appeared with the spelling "gravcouch" in the short story "[[An Offer They Couldn't Refuse]]" in the [[1995]] West End Games sourcebook ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''<ref name="AOTCR" /> and in the short story "[[An Extinct Guest]]," which was part of the "[[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]]" article in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 14|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 14]].<ref name="AEG" /> As the "gravcouch" spelling is more widely used, this article uses the gravcouch spelling for consistency.<ref name="AOTCR" /><ref name="AEG" />
